svg.title: Solvable Muon matrix model with a common warmup

cc:Work.dc:title: Solvable Muon matrix model with a common warmup
cc:Work.dc:description: Exact polar update with no momentum and isotropic tangent noise. Shared prescribed five-step linear warmup and common peak, followed by 95 updates. The exact tail is optimal conditional on this prefix; other tail shapes share the same peak and are not amplitude tuned. All axes are linear. Learning rates extend to the unused t=100 budget boundary. Optimality applies only to this matrix model, not neural-network training.
